name: Beldin Steelgrill
summary: At Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh, Beldin Steelgrill keeps dwarven war machines running. Across Khaz Modan, he is renowned as a master technician, repairing siege engines and armored wagons with a steady supply of specialized tools.

sections.title: Master of the Treaded Beast
sections.body: Just down the road from Kharanos, Steelgrill's Depot tests and services steam tanks and siege engines. The work strains heavy wrenches, cutters, and precision instruments against metal and rumbling boilers. Beldin needs replacements constantly, keeping local ironworkers busy at his bench.

faq.answer: Beldin Steelgrill runs Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh as its proprietor and master technician. Across Khaz Modan, he is famed for maintaining dwarven siege engines and war wagons.
Just northeast of Kharanos, Steelgrill's Depot is a yard where the Alliance tests and maintains steam tanks and heavy mechanized machines.

faq.q: Why does Beldin go through so many tools?
faq.answer: Beldin's work on heavy armor, complex gears, and steam boilers wears through specialized tools quickly. Nearby smiths fill his demanding orders and keep his bench supplied.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can see dwarven vehicle craft at work in Beldin's yard, where the Alliance's formidable war machines are maintained.
As a dwarf, you can see Ironforge's industrial craft at Beldin's yard, where dwarven skill reaches beyond hand tools to siege artillery.
